title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
summary: A precise and unflappable English gentleman bets his friends that he can circle the globe in eighty days. With his resourceful servant, he races across continents while a detective tracks him.
readIf: you want a cheerful, quick-moving classic where every obstacle is another reason to enjoy the ride.
skipIf: you want deep characters; the fun is in the speed and the clever logistics.

pairings.reason: Another Verne adventure, moodier and more scientific, which takes the reader below the waves.
A comfortable, fussy hero is dragged on a long trip and discovers he enjoys it.
An equally breezy, comic journey, with the whole universe in place of the globe.
